### How to use
- Load tokens.css before your own styles. 
- Without a data-theme attribute the page follows the system setting; set data-theme="light" or data-theme="dark" on the html element to force one.
- Spacing: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px. Type sizes: 12, 14, 18, 24, 30, 36, 48 px, body 18 px, line-height 1.5. Weights: 400 and 700.
- Controls: 32, 40, 48 px high; every click or tap area at least 44 px. Breakpoints: 640, 768, 1024, 1280 px (copy the numbers into media queries).
- Brand colour on at most 5% of a screen: links, focus ring, one highlight per page.
- Font: Atkinson Hyperlegible, then the system stack. Load the font files yourself; these tokens add no font files, imports or links.
